questions.question: Jesus told the crowds not to do what the scribes and Pharisees do. Why not?

answers.text: They do not practice what they preach
They copy the customs of foreigners
They do not keep the Sabbath day

questions.question: Jesus said the scribes and Pharisees do all their deeds for what purpose?

answers.text: So the poor will be fed

questions.question: Jesus told His listeners not to be called instructors because they have only one Instructor. Who is He?
According to Jesus, who is the greatest among His listeners?

answers.text: The one who is their servant
The one with the best seat
The one who teaches the most
